evidence_status: Prospectively frozen structural simulation. Pilot acceptance is observed on four constructed missions; all extrapolation, buyers, demand, liabilities, costs, price response, training and collections are modeled assumptions.

human_reference.rate_basis: within sourced Arc backend USD61–80/h band

cost_basis: Every production configuration receives the same assumed token/compute cost and service-capacity charge. USD2 model charge corresponds to assumed aggregate100k input/20k output at sourced Astra10/50USD per million. Observed hosted elapsed is not charged as CPU/API time. No routine human labor is compulsory; sensitivity adds explicit residual minutes.
quality_extrapolation: Beta(accepted+1, attempted-accepted+1), shared quantile seed for identical sufficient statistics. This is an assumed exchangeability model, not calibrated service quality. Equal pilot counts cannot generate Monte Carlo quality differences.
selection_objective: 0.5*mean modeled profit + 0.5*10th percentile; each arm may choose price and reserve from identical declared grid using development tapes only; lexical tie-break. Shared/library selected jointly because their content, permissions, delivery and distribution costs are identical.
candidate_selection: After at least six observed delivery outcomes, screen a bounded optional assessment using past arrival rate, remaining horizon, allowed quality benefit and complete remaining expense. Positive reachability is not admission. Six hypothetical new paired assay clusters yield lower confidence bound; simulated monetary values are not the actual unmetered pilot or native production permission.
gym_selection: Compare conservative prior incremental benefit with cost and capacity using past demand only; optional. Primary prior can imply holding cash. Any sampled training outcome can be negative; no proprietary weights are changed.
new_offering: Four-component pack requires all four pilot missions accepted for that configuration, successful same-budget modeled prototype and future profitable quote. All policies receive same requests and may prototype. Simulated demand and feasibility do not establish a real commercial crossing.
information_boundary: Generate common opportunity/world tape separately. Policy code receives only current quote and past outcomes. Latent quality, hidden acceptance, future demand and future obsolescence are used by environment execution, never by action choice.
native_admission: Actual four-task pilot cannot satisfy unchanged six-cluster monetary evidence gate. All optional admissions here are hypothetical simulated future evidence, not production admission.
units: Integer USD cents. Source metadata and assumptions never become observed receipts. Cash expenses only in profit; displaced capacity reported separately, not charged again.
correction_policy: Keep source/results of any failed confirmation. Correct code with explicit deviation and fresh seeds, never silently retune selection to confirmation.
resources: Two modeled recipients share the same12 daily capacity units in every policy. Private method stays with recipient0; shared and identical-content library can serve either. No graph premium; no live identities. Each single job reserves2units for up to2attempts, each four-component pack reserves8; these fixed maximum reservations deliberately retain unused attempt capacity.
candidate_bound: Per-cluster monetary pair support is [-(price-basic_attempt_cost), +(price-basic_attempt_cost)]. Necessary upper support is full positive margin, not a posterior mean or expected improvement. Reachability includes all remaining assessment/retention/share/maintenance/use costs. Forecast plausibility is separate from support.
validator_correlation: One common world-level delivery-validator error plus independent per-attempt error. Stress raises common delivery error from2%to15% and common paired-assay error from2%to30%; errors can generate false admissions/refunds. All probabilities assumed.
solvency: Before a job, reserve the declared maximum two-attempt expense, correction, quote and optional reuse charge. Hold collected contract cash through its14-day refund window regardless of hidden actual quality. Stop future production if unencumbered cash cannot cover recurring modeled expense; settle existing obligations. Capacity worst-case2/8 includes retries.
